description:
The Huffy Cadence Electric Bike makes commuting, recreation, and daily transportation feel easier than ever. A powerful 350W rear hub motor delivers smooth assistance up to 20 mph, helping you spend less energy on hills and headwinds and more time enjoying the ride.
An integrated 36V lithium-ion battery provides up to 40 miles of range per charge, giving you the freedom to tackle longer rides and everyday errands with ease. The Shimano 6-speed drivetrain adapts smoothly to changing terrain, making every route feel more manageable and enjoyable.
Front and rear disc brakes deliver dependable stopping power when you need it most, while the LCD display keeps key ride information within easy view, including speed, battery level, distance, and ride mode. UL 2849 certified electrical systems, plus practical features like fenders, a bell, and a kickstand, make the Cadence a smart choice for everyday riding.
